name: Grace Naturals Strength and Growth Collection
tagline: Grow stronger, shed less, retain more length.
description: If your hair is growing slowly, sheds more than normal, breaks easily, has weak or fragile strands, struggles to retain length, has thinning areas — including along the hairline — or simply needs stronger, healthier-looking hair from root to tip, this collection is for you. It supports healthy hair growth, helps reduce excessive shedding, strengthens weak and fragile hair, reduces breakage, improves length retention, and promotes fuller, thicker-looking hair. Nourishes hair from root to tip, leaving it stronger, healthier, and more resilient.
